carry_rule: owner decision 2026-11-13: tau = 3 years, the 12-quarter explicit macro forecast (open question #5), so the carried cycle mismatch fades on the forecast's time scale (paras 49, 124); applied only if the jump check flags a segment after the state-specific decay. Secondary: smallest tau within 5% of the best development error (rule set after seeing the results) = 3; development argmin = inf (failed OOT)

selection.stage_A: all periods' year-1 hazard/PIT within tolerance, then the lowest vintage default error
selection.stage_B: dev_train log-likelihood not below the stage-A choice, then the lowest vintage prepayment error (years 1-3)
selection.stage_C: state-specific delinquency decay in the default equation (owner decision 2026-11-13); shared fade reported
selection.stage_D: D2 (incentive x age 2-5y) adopted only if it moves the 2012-16 vintage lifetime PD at origination or the 2023-12 lifetime PD by > 5% vs D1 and does not lower the dev_train log-likelihood

data_note: US Freddie Mac data and US macro (FRED); not Indian risk estimates
